intro: I photograph weddings across Auckland and beyond, capturing the day with a calm, considered approach.
introBody:
My focus is on creating images that feel natural, effortless, and true to you — without over-direction or anything feeling forced. The result is a collection of photographs that not only look beautiful, but feel genuine and lasting over time.

Based in Auckland, available throughout New Zealand.

stories.title: Love stories
stories.text: Each wedding I photograph is different, shaped by the people, the setting, and the moments that unfold naturally throughout the day. These are real weddings of real couples.

approach.title: My approach
approach.body:
A calm, unobtrusive approach. I understand that most couples don’t want to feel like they’re on display all day. My role is to create space for you to enjoy your wedding, while quietly documenting everything as it happens. When guidance is needed, I’ll step in with a light touch — enough to help you feel comfortable, but never enough to interrupt the natural flow of the day.

The focus is always on capturing moments that feel real, relaxed, and timeless.

closing.title: Let’s talk about your day
closing.body: If you’re planning your wedding and are looking for a photographer who will capture it in a natural, refined way, I’d love to hear about your plans.
